subject: Media Technology Shop Profile
overview: Instructor Mr. Hester and students presented an overview of the Media Technology shop at Medford Vocational Technical High School, detailing the skills taught and potential career pathways in video and audio production.

items.title: Media Technology Shop Overview
items.summary: Instructor Mr. Hester and students described hands-on learning opportunities in camera operation, editing, audio production, and performing, as well as plans for higher education and careers in media.
